keyPoints: Syphilis rates in Southwark remain substantially above the national average across boroughs.
Late diagnoses remain disproportionately higher among heterosexual and Black African communities.
A new sexual reproductive health service opened at Harold Moody Health Centre.

timeline.voiceoverText: While syphilis and gonorrhoea rates rise, council services are expanding local clinics to tackle late HIV diagnoses.
Across five London boroughs, the five-year strategy aims to widen digital access and protect vulnerable community groups.
